# authsignal_number_verify_authenticator_configuration (Resource)

Manages the tenant's Number Verify authenticator configuration, which verifies a phone number with the user's mobile carrier. Destroying the resource deletes the configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "authsignal_number_verify_authenticator_configuration" "number_verify" {
  app_id      = "your-app-registration-id"
  environment = "PRODUCTION"
  region      = "NA_01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The app registration ID assigned when your app was registered with the carrier network.

### Optional

- `environment` (String) Whether to verify against live carrier networks or simulated carrier responses. Defaults to `PRODUCTION`. One of `PRODUCTION`, `SANDBOX`.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `region` (String) The carrier network region used in production. One of `NA_01`.

### Read-Only

- `authenticator_id` (String)
- `verification_method` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import authsignal_number_verify_authenticator_configuration.number_verify number-verify
```
